_comment: Opt-in LLM summarization, configured via an explicit baseUrl (works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
OFF by default: this stage only runs because BOTH the top-level llm block exists AND compression.default.llmSummary is true below.
When enabled, over-budget, non-security-sensitive tool outputs are sent to the configured endpoint - and nothing else, nowhere else. Do not enable if that is not acceptable for your data.
apiKey is required when using an explicit baseUrl (no provider preset to fall back to). Set the LLM_API_KEY environment variable, or replace the ${LLM_API_KEY} reference below with your own.
Replace baseUrl and model with your provider's values.
For known providers with a shorthand 'provider' field instead of baseUrl, see config.llm-orcarouter.json.
